about: Every credential the project holds: what it is for, who holds it, what it can reach and when it expires (P5-S3-T01; 07 S6.1: 'Put the token's expiry date into the staleness report so it becomes a countdown rather than an outage'). NAMES AND DATES ONLY: no value is ever written here. Values live as repository Actions secrets and, on the maintainer's machine, in Windows Credential Manager under the service 'uaibi'.

secrets.name: UAIBI_BOT_PAT
secrets.purpose: opens the ingest and intake pull requests, so that pr-validate.yml runs on them unattended (07 S6.1)
secrets.scope: benchmarkg/benchmarks only; contents: read and write, pull requests: read and write, metadata: read

secrets.name: GH_API_TOKEN
secrets.purpose: the GitHub metadata crawl: 5,000 requests an hour where GITHUB_TOKEN gives 1,000 (07 S3.2)
secrets.note: Issued without an expiry, so the benchmarkg organization refuses it (its policy blocks tokens living over 366 days). Harmless for its purpose, which reads other people's public repositories, but re-issue it with an expiry and record the date here.

secrets.name: IA_SPN_KEY
secrets.purpose: Wayback Save Page Now 2 captures (06 S7.1, S3.18)
secrets.scope: SPN2 on 2026-09-29: 3 concurrent captures, 30,000 a day

secrets.name: HF_TOKEN
secrets.purpose: the HuggingFace Hub adapter: 1,000 API requests per 5 minutes where anonymous gets 500 (07 S3.2)

secrets.name: OPENALEX_API_KEY
secrets.purpose: the adoption gate's citation instrument (13 S0.2; docs/adoption/instruments.md)
secrets.note: 07 S3.2 names this OPENALEX_KEY; P8-S1-T01's verification names OPENALEX_API_KEY, which is the name held.

secrets.name: SEMANTIC_SCHOLAR_API_KEY
secrets.purpose: arXiv-to-paper identity resolution (06 S3.11) and the adoption gate's citation instrument (13 S0.2)
secrets.scope: 1 request per second, across all endpoints
secrets.note: 07 S3.2 names this S2_API_KEY; P8-S1-T01's verification names SEMANTIC_SCHOLAR_API_KEY, which is the name held.

secrets.name: CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN
secrets.purpose: deploys the site to the Cloudflare Worker (08 S7.2; P2-S7-T01)

secrets.name: R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID
secrets.purpose: the R2 artifact bucket for execution runs (13 S4.3; P8-S2-T03)
secrets.kind: S3-compatible access key (paired with R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, at R2_ENDPOINT)
secrets.note: The endpoint refused a TLS handshake on 2026-09-29: R2 is probably not enabled on the account yet. Not needed before P8-S2-T03.

secrets.name: R2_ENDPOINT
secrets.purpose: the account's R2 S3 API endpoint
secrets.kind: URL (not secret in itself; it names the account)

variables.name: CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID
variables.purpose: the Cloudflare account the Worker and R2 live in

not_yet_held.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
not_yet_held.purpose: the arXiv triage classifier (06 S5.2; 07 S10) and tools/copilot/draft.py
